worldimport.title: Import a world file
worldimport.intro: Check what is in the file. Nothing is imported until you press "Import world".
worldimport.heading: What the file holds
worldimport.zone.label: World file
worldimport.loads.none: None: the world makes its map when it first starts.
worldimport.password_warning: The game password was not in the file. This world will start with no password until you set one in Game settings.
worldimport.mods_warning: Foreman does not check what the saves and mods in this file hold. Import only a file you trust. A mod can keep anything its author chose, a token included.
worldimport.name.label: World name
worldimport.image.here: The game image for version {version} is already on this host.
worldimport.error.bad: This is not a world file Foreman can read. It may be damaged, cut short, or not exported by Foreman.
worldimport.error.newer: A newer version of Foreman made this world file, so this version cannot read it. Update Foreman and try again.
worldimport.refused.title: Foreman cannot import this file
worldimport.gone.title: The uploaded file is gone
worldimport.gone: Foreman keeps an uploaded world file for one hour, and this one is no longer here. Upload it again.
